scope: Closest prior art for shift-aware dynamic adaptation policy selection; selected primary reading only, no experiments.

sources.title: Shift-level regulated continual test-time adaptation framework
sources.venue: Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery 40, article 63
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract, metadata, data availability and visible reference list; subscription full text not read.
sources.method_overlap: ASLD categorizes aligned/weak/strong shifts; ASDM selects corresponding adaptation strategies. This directly overlaps shift inference followed by policy selection.
sources.limitation: Exact detector, objectives and protocol require full text. Do not infer omitted experiments from paywall. No code verified.

sources.title: Hybrid-TTA: Continual Test-time Adaptation via Dynamic Domain Shift Detection
sources.publicationstatus: Conference paper; arXiv first September 2024, inspected v2 August 2025
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction, section 4 mechanism and experiment/appendix headings; selected results, not exhaustive full paper.
sources.method_overlap: Teacher/student discrepancy with dynamic loss thresholding detects domain changes and switches between full tuning and adapter tuning for each input.
sources.limitation: Segmentation-specific FT/ET menu and reconstruction preparation; not a general selector over arbitrary TTA algorithms. Still invalidates broad novelty of dynamic policy switching.

sources.title: BECoTTA: Input-dependent Online Blending of Experts for Continual Test-time Adaptation
sources.publicationstatus: Conference paper; arXiv v3 31 May 2024 inspected
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction, method and benchmark design descriptions plus author project page.
sources.method_overlap: Pseudo-domain inference routes inputs to low-rank experts; updates relevant experts and blends domain-adaptive knowledge.
sources.limitation: Expert routing is distinct from selecting complete standalone TTA methods. Initialization and source augmentation variants must be distinguished; gradual/mixed shifts alone are covered.

sources.title: MORPHEUS: Meta Test-Time Adaptation via Neural Collapse Geometry
sources.publicationstatus: Workshop paper, not main-track ICLR; author research page corroborates
sources.read_scope: Indexed primary OpenReview PDF abstract, introduction and section 2 excerpts; live direct PDF fetch encountered browser challenge.
sources.method_overlap: Predicts per-TTA post-adaptation accuracy from source-model entropy and Neural-Collapse embedding statistics, then selects a complete TTA method without executing all candidates. Direct collision with a learned pre-adaptation router.
sources.limitation: Detailed meta-training split/code require further verification. Do not claim feature-only method selection or cheap single-forward routing is new.

sources.title: TTN: A Domain-Shift Aware Batch Normalization in Test-Time Adaptation
sources.read_scope: Abstract and author project-page sections on layer/channel shift sensitivity and post-training.
sources.method_overlap: Combines source and current-batch normalization using layer/channel shift sensitivity; shifts alter appropriate reliance on source/test statistics.
sources.limitation: Interpolation weights are learned using labeled source data during post-training and frozen at deployment. Do not conflate this with label-free source preparation or whole-method routing.

sources.title: DATTA: Domain Diversity Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Dynamic Domain Shift Data Streams
sources.publicationstatus: Accepted oral per author arXiv record; DOI 10.1109/ICME59968.2025.11209053; preprint first2024, v2 Dec2025 inspected
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction, method overview and section headings.
sources.method_overlap: Recognizes single-versus-multiple-domain batches, changes normalization interpolation and selectively fine-tunes to mitigate gradient conflict.
sources.limitation: Domain diversity is not physical shift-cause identification. Dynamic heterogeneous input batches already studied; a generic multi-domain claim is insufficient.

sources.title: A Layer Selection Approach to Test Time Adaptation
sources.publicationstatus: Accepted per arXiv record; firstpreprint April2024, v2 Feb2025 inspected
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction, section2 description, discussion/appendix analysis of current gradients versus accumulated state.
sources.method_overlap: Uses proposed gradients relative to accumulated parameter displacement to select one layer, skip updates or reset alignment history. Adaptation utility depends on state, loss and shift.
sources.limitation: Selecting update layers is not arbitrary whole-method selection, but state/drift/gradient features and skip/reset are established; cannot sell these alone as a gap.

sources.title: Shift-ACT: Test-time adaptation via shift-aware class-specific dynamic thresholding for domain generalization
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract/metadata and author repository README.
sources.method_overlap: Class-specific source-target confidence gaps adjust thresholds; reliable samples get entropy minimization, unreliable samples get prototype contrastive alignment.
sources.limitation: Source-derived class confidence information required; selected method passages/full detailed protocol not read. Class-wise signal-dependent objective choice is already present.

sources.title: Shift-Aware Test Time Adaptation and Benchmarking for Time-Series Forecasting
sources.venue: ICML 2025 Workshop on Test-Time Adaptation: Putting Updates to the Test!
sources.publicationstatus: Workshop oral, not verified main-track ICML; official workshop list verifies acceptance
sources.read_scope: Indexed primary PDF abstract/introduction excerpts, official workshop list and author talk summary.
locations: Introduction dynamic rate and shift-conditioned gating
sources.method_overlap: Prediction-error and embedding-drift signals control adaptation rate and reliance on adapted outputs, with synthetic shifted forecast benchmark.
sources.limitation: Forecasting can reveal past outcomes as future inputs; does not automatically satisfy strict label-free classification protocol.

sources.title: RG-TTA: Regime-Guided Meta-Control for Test-Time Adaptation in Streaming Time Series
sources.read_scope: Abstract,introduction,method outline and limitations/ablation table of contents.
sources.method_overlap: Uses similarity to stored regimes to scale learning rate, stop updates when loss plateaus and reuse checkpoints only when predicted loss benefit passes a gate.
sources.limitation: Temporal forecasting setup has observed outcomes; checkpoint bank/rate controller is not fully unlabeled image-classification method selection.

sources.title: AdaTent++: reliability-guided hybrid test-time adaptation for traffic sign detection under distribution shift
sources.read_scope: Publisher full text selectively read: abstract, sections2.1–2.4, ablations, discussion, limitations and conclusion.
sources.method_overlap: Entropy and multiview agreement route to BN-stat update, guarded BN-affine update or skip; EMA/hysteresis, dynamic1–2steps and BN rollback stabilize.
sources.limitation: §5 admits benchmark-condition IDs for views/filtering, one deterministic run and no longstream. §4 says not compute-matched despite conflicting conclusion wording. §6 requests budget-aware adaptive viewcount/step controllers. No guarantees verified.

sources.title: HD-TTA: Hypothesis-Driven Test-Time Adaptation for Safer Brain Tumor Segmentation
sources.venue: MICCAI2026 (official page found); inspected arXiv preprint
sources.read_scope: arXiv abstract and official MICCAI paper-page abstract/review summaries; full method not read.
sources.method_overlap: Gatekeeper skips confident masks; competing compaction/inflation hypotheses are scored by intrinsic representation consistency to select safer refinement.
sources.limitation: Clinical binary segmentation proof of concept; not evidence a general classification method selector is new. Code was promised on acceptance; release not verified.

sources.title: MoETTA: Test-Time Adaptation Under Mixed Distribution Shifts with MoE-LayerNorm
sources.publicationstatus: Acceptance reported by authorarXiv; firstpreprint14November2025; v1 inspected
sources.method_overlap: LayerNorm experts permit sample-specific gradient directions under mixed shifts; potpourri mixes natural/artistic/adversarial shifts, potpourri+ includes source examples.
sources.limitation: Mixed domains/source returns are covered as benchmarks; action-menu policy selection and image-level composed corruptions remain distinct, but no novelty inferred from this distinction.

sources.title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Entropy Sensitivity-Guidance in Strict Online Setting
sources.read_scope: arXiv abstract/metadata only; HTML unavailable and code link fetch failed.
sources.method_overlap: Structured erasure probes produce entropy-sensitivity trajectories for recovery/sample selection and reduce backward updates in batchsizeonecontinual streams.
sources.limitation: Evidence probes and sensitivity gating already proposed. Adaptive purchasing of probe types/counts is not established by the read abstract; fullmethod/code needed before negativeclaim.

sources.title: MoASE++: Mixture of Activation Sparsity Experts with Domain-Adaptive On-policy Distillation for Continual Test Time Adaptation
sources.method_overlap: Domain-aware router weights experts using texture cues; entropy/confidence condition augmentation policy and EMA distillation.
sources.limitation: Dynamic expertcomposition and signal-conditioned augmentation arecovered. Fullimplementation/evaluationnotread; do not infer costed evidence acquisitionabsent.
